subtitle: Astrology, Horoscope & Rituals
promotional_text: Your personal cosmic guide — daily horoscopes, birth chart insights, love compatibility, AI oracle, and sacred rituals in one elegant app.
description:
Astronode is your personal cosmos companion.

Get daily horoscopes and rituals tailored to you. Explore Vedic and Western astrology, decode relationship compatibility, ask the AI Oracle about your chart and timing, and capture reflections in your cosmic journal.

FEATURES
• Daily horoscope & meditation rituals
• Birth chart overview across traditions
• Love & relationship compatibility scores
• AI Astrology Oracle chat
• Astral feed — articles on astrology, tarot & crystals
• Cosmic journal, voice notes & manifestations
• Power Moves — planetary timing for success

Whether you follow Vedic, Western, Chinese astrology, or numerology, Astronode brings your chart into focus with a calm, premium experience.

Symbolic guidance only — not medical, legal, or financial advice.
whats_new: Refined cosmic experience with daily rituals, relationship insights, AI Oracle guidance, and a clearer birth-chart overview.
